full_judgment: 2. Facts, in short, are that the present opposite Party No. 1 as petitioner filed Miscellaneous Case No. 22 of 1994 for preemption of the case land under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act against the opposite parties on the assertions that the petitioner of the aforesaid miscellaneous case is the co-sharer of the disputed holding recorded in SA Khatian No. 236 by way of inheritance. The petitioner's co-sharer Dr Aftab Uddin transferred the case land to the opposite party Nos. 1 and 2 on the basis of a heba-bil-ewaz deed dated 29-7-93 without any notice to the petitioner. Hence the case upon deposit of an amount of Taka 5,000 together with the statutory compensation.
